title: Due-Date Change Limits for Retail Installment Contracts by Tier
content:
A borrower of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts may move the monthly due day later within the limits of the contract's tier.

| Tier | Installments paid before a change, at least | Days past due on the request date, at most | Days the next due date may move later in one change, at most | Changes per rolling 12 months, at most | Changes over the contract's life, at most | Allowed due days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 6 | 0 | 15 | 1 | 1 | 1st to 28th |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 6 | 0 | 15 | 1 | 2 | 1st to 28th |
| Tier 4 Standard | 4 | 0 | 15 | 1 | 2 | 1st to 28th |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 4 | 0 | 20 | 1 | 2 | 1st to 28th |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 3 | 9 | 20 | 2 | 3 | 1st to 28th |
| Tier 1 Select | 3 | 9 | 20 | 2 | 3 | 1st to 28th |

The allowed due days are an inclusive range, from day 1 through day 28 of the month, at every tier.

**Points of reading.**

- A contract 4 days past due on the request date is within the 9-day limit of Tier 2 Preferred and Tier 1 Select, and outside the 0-day limit of the other tiers.
- A Tier 6 Fresh Start contract has one change available over its whole life; once one change is on record, no further change is available at that tier.
- A due day of the 30th or 31st lies outside the allowed range at every tier.
